Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000193": The webhooks service relies on the bus for outbound events, so if the bus is down, the webhooks service is down.  (about: the bus, webhook dispatcher)
- memory_id "1000055": The Boreal team looks after the bus.  (about: Boreal team, the bus)
- memory_id "1000412" [constraint]: As of 2025-05-29, anything Boreal-related should be paged to Marcus.  (about: Boreal team, Marcus)
- memory_id "1000394": As of 2025-05-15, the webhook dispatcher is owned by the Boreal team.  (about: Boreal team, webhook dispatcher)
- memory_id "1000438": On 2025-06-09, the Ember team handed the billing API to the Boreal team.  (about: Boreal team, billing API, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000446": As of 2025-06-09, the billing API lives with the Boreal team.  (about: Boreal team, billing API)
- memory_id "1000335" [constraint]: Deploys to the bus happen on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC and at no other time.  (about: the bus)
- memory_id "1000188": The notifier relies on the bus for delivery events, so if the bus is down, the notifier is down.  (about: the bus, notifier)
- memory_id "1000240": As of 2025-03-03, the pager for the webhook dispatcher rings the Ember team.  (about: webhook dispatcher, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000105" [constraint]: The ledger service only ships on weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC.  (about: ledger service)
- memory_id "1000367": On 2025-05-07, the Boreal team noticed the authentication gateway's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump and pinged the owners.  (about: Boreal team, authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000011": As of 2025-01-07, the Boreal team consists of Lena and Marcus.  (about: Boreal team, Lena, Marcus)
- memory_id "1000296" [constraint]: As of 2025-03-31, anything Ember-related should be paged to Oskar.  (about: Ember team, Oskar)
- memory_id "1000390": On 2025-05-15, Oskar walked Lena through the webhook dispatcher runbook as part of the handover.  (about: Lena, webhook dispatcher, Oskar)
- memory_id "1000228": On 2025-02-21, the Boreal team noticed the ledger service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change and pinged the owners.  (about: Boreal team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000360": As of 2025-05-07, Marcus has the Boreal pager, taking over from Lena.  (about: Boreal team, Lena, Marcus)
- memory_id "1000454": As of 2025-06-11, Cinder owns the notifier, which the Boreal team owned until 2025-06-11.  (about: Boreal team, Cinder, notifier)
- memory_id "1000180" [preference]: As of 2025-02-06, the Ember team does pairing on every production change.  (about: Ember team)
- memory_id "1000160" [constraint]: The ledger service must stay on Postgres 14 until the partitioning work finishes.  (about: ledger service)
- memory_id "1000301" [constraint]: Changes to the billing API need a rollback plan attached to the pull request.  (about: billing API)
